Clone the repository: ```sh git clone https://example.com/project.git cd project ``` 2. Install dependencies: ```sh npm install ``` 3. Verify the installation: ```sh npm test ``` ## Usage After completing the steps in [Installation](#install), start the app with: ```sh npm start ``` ``` **How the identifier works** - `{#install}` after the heading sets an explicit anchor ID, so the link target stays `#install` even if you later rename the heading (for example, to "Getting Started"). - Other places in the same document can link with `[Installation](#install)`, as shown in the Usage section. - From other files, link with `guide.md#install` (or the published URL plus `#install`). **Note on compatibility:** the `{#id}` syntax is supported by Pandoc, Python-Markdown (with `attr_list`), kramdown/Jekyll, MkDocs, Hugo, and many others, but not by plain CommonMark or GitHub-flavored Markdown.
